zalgoQualityPolicy.legacyDenseTelemetry: observed for diagnostics only; no dense-cluster quota is required for admission
zalgoQualityPolicy.signatureCanonicalization: sorted combining-codepoint composition; mark-order-only permutations collapse to one signature

zalgoQualityPolicy.horizontalDominantPosture: ADMISSIBLE-with-PARTIAL-telemetry when deep vertical architecture remains present; stack-depth-thin plus axis-collapse or thin-vertical evidence escalates to one same-provider repair
zalgoQualityPolicy.axisCollapsePosture: PARTIAL by itself; when combined with stack-depth-thin it becomes severe morphology, receives one immediate same-provider repair, and is not shown while unresolved
zalgoQualityPolicy.bestPartialPreference: first nonsevere admissible PARTIAL returns immediately; severe morphology is failure-driven repair/fallback rather than comparative aesthetic sampling
zalgoQualityPolicy.throughLineDominanceWarning: planar dominance is acceptable only when genuine multi-tier crown/descender architecture remains visibly healthy
zalgoQualityPolicy.shallowWallpaperPosture: broad repeated one-or-two-accent fields are severe native-voice collapse even when technically vertical; one same-provider Gemini repair re-authors the combining field from scratch before the original PARTIAL may be shown
zalgoQualityPolicy.verticalExpressionThinPosture: PARTIAL by itself; combined with stack-depth-thin it is a severe horizontal-collapse signature requiring the bounded same-provider repair before visibility
zalgoQualityPolicy.dynamicRangePosture: Deep-stack dominance must cover at least 72% of all eligible base letters as well as dominate marked letters; clean breaths count as countertexture. Repeated full-field deep tiling remains a bounded provider repair/fallback condition.
zalgoQualityPolicy.verticalPulsePosture: Combining-heavy fields with no four-mark vertical event trigger bounded native repair regardless of horizontal-mark presence; one-sided crowns or roots qualify without a newline or paired-axis quota. Unresolved absence continues the bounded frontier.
zalgoQualityPolicy.extremeUnderflowDefinition: nonzero marks are insufficient only when the Tauric Diana passage has too few total marks, too few marked graphemes, or fewer than two marked lines; horizontal dominance alone never causes underflow
zalgoQualityPolicy.enclosingOrnamentPosture: SEVERE-native-voice-corruption: combining enclosing circles/squares/keycaps/slashes never count as vertical ornament; one same-provider repair receives a sanitized Packet-B base-text context, and unresolved corruption continues the bounded provider frontier rather than becoming visible
zalgoQualityPolicy.glyphSubstitutionPosture: SEVERE-native-voice-corruption: geometric box/diamond pseudo-letters inside the Latin base stream trigger repair and bounded frontier continuation; visible final bytes remain provider-authored
zalgoQualityPolicy.verticalOrnamentDefinition: only curated true above/below combining species count toward vertical stack depth; planar, enclosing and unclassified combining marks cannot counterfeit crown/root telemetry
zalgoQualityPolicy.localizedBurstPosture: advisory only: localized eruptions and clean breaths cannot establish incorrect semantic placement; independent clone or corruption evidence remains repairable
zalgoQualityPolicy.historyContextPosture: Only previously generated model passages with severe morphology evidence project Packet B as base prose into provider context; user turns, formal channel, successful model turns, stored history and rendered output remain unchanged. Separately, retire the automatic live-Gemini release canary as deployment-success authority: exact-source Vercel deployment now spends zero Gemini calls, while the existing observation workflow becomes an explicit deployment-independent AI witness.
humanOperatorObservation.thirtyFirstCanaryObservation: The Vercel Operator Release had already proven source adoption, exact byte parity, stale-queue stability, Chromium production surfaces and Ash lifecycle before its final live AI canary. Repeated 429/503 provider transport at that last step marked physically successful deployments RED/HELD and consumed scarce Gemini requests without proving a deployment defect.
humanOperatorObservation.thirtyFirstCanaryConsequence: Vercel deployment success no longer invokes loom-production-canary.mjs automatically. The release writes a zero-call deferred-AI receipt and seals from deployment/source/browser evidence. Live Gemini liveness remains available only through the explicit observation workflow, which is read-only, deployment-independent, exact-source guarded, and may bind either a successful or historically held governed release. The canary itself stops hash-rotating model seats and uses explicit task-aligned defaults with environment overrides.
humanOperatorObservation.thirtySecondFollowupObservation: Quota research plus Hush archaeology showed that the nominal 100-call Marrowline figure is an arithmetic five-seat planning capacity, not a provider entitlement. Hush, Marrowline and Loom can compete for the same project/model Gemini buckets; repeated 20-RPD full-Flash buckets therefore become expensive when Marrowline always starts on the same premium seat or spends a second call on optional morphology late in the provider day.
humanOperatorObservation.thirtySecondFollowupConsequence: Add a browser-local Pacific-day quota governor. The shared Gemini ledger derives current Pacific-day call counts by model, remembers the last structured per-model daily limit observed from provider quota receipts without promoting it into provider-wide truth, and sends bounded budget hints with Marrowline turns. The server spreads ordinary premium traffic across the proven 3.8/3.5 pair according to observed same-browser use, demotes a seat that emitted a structured model-daily 429 instead of declaring the provider exhausted, and preserves a two-call local reserve per known model bucket by skipping only the optional High-Zalgo repaint. Hard structural repair and transport fallback remain available. All budget evidence is explicitly partial browser-local evidence; provider_daily_total remains unknown.
humanOperatorObservation.thirtyThirdFollowupObservation: The first human turns after the quota governor succeeded semantically but Tauric Diana output collapsed to low-intensity Zalgo with zero visible vertical flourishings. Archaeology identified the exact regression: the last human-observed beautiful vertical lineage (#1249/#1250) explicitly made crown/root architecture the FIRST scaffold and treated planar marks as accent-only, while later mixed-axis/native-voice prompts relaxed that precedence. The quota governor also began balancing 3.8 against 3.5 by local call count and could suppress the one native-voice repair inside a reserve, even though prior operator evidence showed 3.8 as the stronger first-shot Marrowline seat and vertical morphology is part of the channel contract rather than cosmetics.
humanOperatorObservation.thirtyThirdFollowupConsequence: Restore the proven vertical-first scaffold from #1249/#1250 while retaining the later scream-sing cognitive framing. Reintroduce compact A/R/I crown-root specimens as directional reference, not the later extreme one-word specimen; require crowns/roots on several lines before horizontal/oblique counter-rhythm; make the self-check mentally erase all planar marks and require an obvious vertical field to remain. Preserve 3.8-first provider ordering whenever no structured quota/cooldown evidence requires demotion. Browser call counts remain telemetry, not permission to load-balance Marrowline away from its strongest seat. Native-voice morphology repair is exempt from the browser-local reserve and remains one same-provider Gemini-authored repair; zero local Unicode synthesis remains absolute.
humanOperatorObservation.thirtyFourthFollowupObservation: Fresh physical-iPhone production evidence after #1257 showed a new counterfeit vertical mode: Gemini covered nearly every line with tiny repeated accent-like marks but produced no deep multi-tier towers or wells. The page looked like a dotted comb / cloned shallow accent carpet. This exposed two mistakes: explicit reference specimens were being imitated as a surface pattern, and the local severe-morphology gate did not escalate monoculture/mechanical-clone plus stack-depth collapse unless horizontal-axis collapse was also present.
humanOperatorObservation.thirtyFourthFollowupConsequence: Remove all provider-visible Unicode reference specimens and return to the concise natural-field architecture that preceded the cloning regression. Define verticality explicitly as stack HEIGHT/DEPTH rather than mere above/below POSITION. Ban repeated one-or-two-mark hats, diaeresis-like/dot-like/breve-like/paired accents as low-Zalgo wallpaper. Add shallow-wallpaper telemetry for broad high-coverage fields with only tiny stacks, and classify shallow-wallpaper directly—or stack-depth-thin plus monoculture/mechanical-clone—as severe native-voice collapse eligible for the one same-provider Gemini repair. The repair tells Gemini to preserve the base prose but re-author the combining field from scratch rather than copying the failed mark pattern. Provider-only authorship remains absolute.

Gemini 3.8 returned HTTP 200, then its bounded same-seat repair returned HTTP 200 and cleared the six severe High-Zalgo morphology objections but was HELD only for tauric-diana-bots-nominative-missing. operatorObservation.thirtyEighthFollowupConsequence: Keep the plain dual-voice anchor law. Remove the duplicated native-prosody law from the repair user turn because the same orchestra law already exists in systemInstruction; remove the morphology repair's independent 1–3 paragraph concision target; explicitly preserve wording, sentence order, paragraph boundaries and substantive extent while Gemini re-authors combining marks across the full existing Packet B prose body. operatorObservation.thirtyNinthFollowupObservation: Explicit production re-observation 35648483697 on deployed source 54d32d5d41def347eada1e09764fb42fbbcd3095 confirmed the v39 Marrowline repair under real quota pressure: Gemini 3.8 hit a structured model-daily 429, Gemini 3.5 then returned HTTP 200 with a 40,375-byte streamed response, zero rejected attempts, relay_admitted=true and an admitted human-visible answer. The governed Vercel release 35647975424 itself had already sealed SUCCESS with exact-source receipt, two byte matches, anti-rollback stability, browser and Ash lifecycle checks.
operatorObservation.thirtyNinthFollowupConsequence: Separate deployment health, Marrowline admission and independent Loom provider liveness. Semantic/admission failures, malformed Loom responses, source drift and transport corruption remain blocking. operatorObservation.fortiethFollowupObservation: 2026-09-21 reconciliation after the first #1279 production human attempts exposed two local-governance regressions that could prevent any visible answer despite live provider opportunity. PR #1248 had made browser-persisted model-scoped 429 cooldown receipts authoritative over the next explicit human retry, including a zero-provider-call 429 when every approved seat was marked cooling. Separately, Marrowline could receive Gemini HTTP 200 with nonempty prose and then suppress the provider bytes because local dual-channel structure, High-Zalgo morphology, or MAX_TOKENS admission did not satisfy the house contract. Hush archaeology confirmed that its generation path did not impose the equivalent browser retry veto.
operatorObservation.fortiethFollowupConsequence: Restore the human surface as the custody boundary. Browser cooldown history remains telemetry only for explicit human turns and cannot suppress or reorder the 3.8-first provider frontier; current provider 429/503 responses retain transport authority. For Gemini HTTP 200 with nonempty text, local structure and morphology assessment becomes diagnostic rather than censorship: one same-provider repair may be attempted when lawful, then the exact original provider return remains visible with its NOT_LOCKED/PARTIAL/HELD local assessment preserved in the receipt. Nonempty MAX_TOKENS output is likewise surfaced as truncated provider evidence. Release canaries remain strict and may still HOLD because they are bounded validation witnesses, not the human conversation surface. Zero local Zalgo synthesis and provider-only Unicode authorship remain absolute.
